headline: World Cup: Iran fight back to draw 2-2 with New Zealand in LA
summary: Iran twice overcame a deficit to secure a point in their opening Group G match, played amidst fan protests against the Tehran government.
details: Iran and New Zealand played out a 2-2 draw in their opening World Cup match on Monday in Los Angeles.
New Zealand took the lead twice, with Elijah Just scoring in the 7th minute and again in the 54th minute, both assisted by Chris Wood.
Iran responded each time, with Ramin Rezaeian equalizing in the 32nd minute and Mohammad Mohebbi scoring a header in the 64th minute to seal the draw.
The match was played in a packed stadium with a large Iranian supporting crowd, who also used the platform to protest against the government in Tehran.
Iran will next face Belgium in Los Angeles, while New Zealand will travel to Vancouver to take on Egypt on Sunday.

headline: Tragedy in Jatrabari: Youth killed in road crash
summary: A young man lost his life in a fatal road accident in the Shonir Akhra area of Jatrabari, Dhaka.
details: A youth was killed in a road accident in the Shonir Akhra area of Jatrabari, Dhaka.
The incident occurred on the road, leading to the immediate loss of life of the young man.
Local authorities and witnesses reported the crash, which has left the community in shock.
Further details regarding the cause of the accident and the accident vehicle are still being determined.
